testCase:
S-06: Compare battery life on two product pages
Goal: Add whichever of the Auralix Pulse and Kovix AirTone wireless earbuds has the longer battery life with the charging case to my cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-06/
STEP 2: Search for "wireless earbuds"
STEP 3: Open "Auralix Pulse Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" and "Kovix AirTone Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" and compare "Battery life (with charging case)" in the Specifications tab
STEP 4: Add the one with the longer battery life to the cart
STEP 5: Verify "Added to cart: 1 × Auralix Pulse Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" is visible
